releases.name: v0.6.0 — V2 entry, compaction freeze
releases.body:
V2 entrypoint and compaction freeze.

- Adds `v2.js`, loaded by directory (`file://…/opencode-consistent`), registering `ctx.session.hook("context")` and `session.hook("compaction")`.
- Freezes env/AGENTS.md/skills/MCP prose so the prompt head stays byte-identical.
- Holds the tool block in both directions: tools added after the snapshot are dropped, tools removed are restored from stored definitions.
- Compaction shares the session prefix: measured `cache.read` 137,216 against 579,597 → 0 before the fix.

Install: `npm i opencode-consistent@0.6.0`
